examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A reply field: write Markdown, format it from the toolbar or with Ctrl/⌘+B, I and K, check it on the Preview tab, and type @ to mention a teammate from `mentions`.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled` turns off the field, the toolbar, the tabs and the mention menu.

examples.name: Readonly
examples.summary: `readonly` opens on the Preview tab and hides the toolbar, so a reader sees the rendered note; Write still shows the source. This note uses every format.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Inside a Field with an error: `invalid` draws the danger border on the field and the preview.

examples.name: WithFooter
examples.summary: The composer of a ticket: the `footer` slot holds an attach button and the Send reply button under the field.
